summary: First Mining Gold Corp., a Canadian gold developer listed on the TSX and quoted OTCQX, furnished a Form 6-K (the US foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a voluntary current report) attaching a press release dated November 11, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 financial results and operating highlights for the period ended September 30, 2026. Cited items include federal environmental-assessment approval for the Springpole project, project benefit agreements with three Indigenous communities, Duparquet drilling results, GDXJ index inclusion, and a previously closed C$0.84-per-share bought deal raising about $57.5M. No transaction, stake, premium or board recommendation is present; the filing is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
